2121612290755629402.en_summary: $VST energy is next bottleneck. Power generation for a grid that data centers are straining. Its guide was raised last quarter, and the demand engine is simple: AI needs electricity, and it needs it near where the data centers are. The long-term case is contracted power in a short market.
2121612290755629402.zh_summary: $VST 能源是下一個瓶頸。數據中心正在緊張的電網的發電。上季指引上調，需求引擎簡單：AI需要電力，且需要在數據中心附近。長期理由是短缺市場中的合約電力。

2121611745567347121.en_summary: $IREN cheaper at this price IMO. A miner turned AI cloud provider: its AI cloud revenue grew 182% in a quarter at an 86% gross margin, with a $20.3B backlog behind it. The pivot is real and the numbers show it; the $4B-plus annual revenue target slipped to early next year, so the timeline, not the direction, is what to watch.
2121611745567347121.zh_summary: $IREN 在這個價格更便宜，我認為。礦工轉變為AI雲提供商：其AI雲收入一季增長182%，毛利率86%，背後有203億美元積壓。轉型是真實的，數字顯示了；超過40億美元的年度收入目標滑到明年初，所以時間線而非方向是需要關注的。

2121611426418594110.en_summary: $NBIS not finding bottom yet. A neocloud renting AI capacity, growing fast: revenue nearly $1B last quarter, annualized run-rate revenue of $6.4B. The honest distinction is the funding plan — 2027 revenue of $12-13B against $40-45B of capex, with prepayments and contract-backed financing meant to cover most of it. The demand is contracted; the question is whether the balance sheet carries the build.
2121611426418594110.zh_summary: $NBIS 尚未找到底部。租用AI容量的新雲，快速增長：上季收入近10億美元，年化運行率收入64億美元。誠實的區別是融資計劃——2027年收入120-130億美元對比400-450億美元資本支出，預付款和合同支持融資旨在覆蓋大部分。需求已簽約；問題是資產負債表是否能承載建設。
